$comment: Single source for Peak's --peak-* inputs. `npm run tokens` regenerates src/inputs.css and the README table. Ships in the npm package, so editors (sliders, pickers) can generate their controls from it: `label`, `doc`, `min`/`max`/`step`, `options`, and for inputs that are unset by default `toggle` (the label of the checkbox that switches them on) and `start` (the value to start from). Renaming or removing a token is a breaking change (docs/PLAN.md R3).

logo-size.label: Logo size
logo-size.doc: Height of the logo image in the site title

hue.label: Brand hue
hue.doc: OKLCH hue of the brand color

chroma.label: Brand saturation
chroma.doc: OKLCH chroma of the brand color

brand.label: Brand color
brand.toggle: Use a brand color instead of hue and saturation
brand.doc: Picker path: takes hue and chroma from any color and overrides the two above. Lightness is still set per scheme

neutral-chroma.label: Neutral tint
neutral-chroma.doc: Tints surfaces, text and borders toward the brand hue (or the neutral hue)

neutral-hue.label: Neutral hue
neutral-hue.toggle: Use a separate hue for neutrals
neutral-hue.doc: Hue of the neutral tint (surfaces, text, borders, contrast); unset follows the brand hue

neutral-hue-dark.label: Dark neutral hue
neutral-hue-dark.toggle: Use a separate neutral hue in dark mode
neutral-hue-dark.doc: Hue of the dark scheme's surfaces and borders, e.g. warm paper in light mode and a cool night in dark mode; unset follows the neutral hue

ink-hue.label: Text hue
ink-hue.toggle: Tint text with a hue of its own
ink-hue.doc: Hue of text, headings, muted text and the contrast color; unset follows the neutral ramp

ink-chroma.label: Text tint
ink-chroma.doc: OKLCH chroma of text; applies only with `--peak-ink-hue`

secondary-hue.label: Secondary hue
secondary-hue.doc: Makes secondary a color of its own; unset, secondary is the neutral ramp tinted four times as strongly

secondary-chroma.label: Secondary saturation
secondary-chroma.doc: OKLCH chroma of the secondary color; applies only with `--peak-secondary-hue`

accent-hue.label: Accent hue
accent-hue.doc: Hue of the accent color, for highlights used sparingly (badges, icons)

accent-chroma.label: Accent saturation
accent-chroma.doc: OKLCH chroma of the accent color

accent-color.label: Accent color
accent-color.toggle: Use an accent color instead of hue and saturation
accent-color.doc: Picker path for the accent, like `--peak-brand`: hue and chroma come from the color (chroma capped at 0.25), lightness is set per use

status-chroma.label: Status saturation
status-chroma.doc: Shared by the four status colors

dark-fills.label: Deep fills in dark mode
dark-fills.doc: 1: primary and secondary buttons keep the light scheme's deep fill with white text in dark mode, instead of a light fill with dark text

bg-light.label: Page background, light
bg-light.doc: Exact light-scheme color for `--peak-bg`, the page background; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

bg-dark.label: Page background, dark
bg-dark.doc: Exact dark-scheme color for `--peak-bg`, the page background; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

surface-light.label: Surface, light
surface-light.doc: Exact light-scheme color for `--peak-surface`: cards, inputs, menus; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

surface-dark.label: Surface, dark
surface-dark.doc: Exact dark-scheme color for `--peak-surface`: cards, inputs, menus; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

text-light.label: Text, light
text-light.doc: Exact light-scheme color for `--peak-text`, body text; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

text-dark.label: Text, dark
text-dark.doc: Exact dark-scheme color for `--peak-text`, body text; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

heading-light.label: Headings, light
heading-light.doc: Exact light-scheme color for `--peak-heading` and every heading level; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

heading-dark.label: Headings, dark
heading-dark.doc: Exact dark-scheme color for `--peak-heading` and every heading level; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

muted-light.label: Muted text, light
muted-light.doc: Exact light-scheme color for `--peak-muted`: captions, placeholders, hints; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

muted-dark.label: Muted text, dark
muted-dark.doc: Exact dark-scheme color for `--peak-muted`: captions, placeholders, hints; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

border-light.label: Borders, light
border-light.doc: Exact light-scheme color for `--peak-border`: rules, card and table borders; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

border-dark.label: Borders, dark
border-dark.doc: Exact dark-scheme color for `--peak-border`: rules, card and table borders; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

secondary-fill-light.label: Secondary fill, light
secondary-fill-light.doc: Exact light-scheme color for `--peak-secondary-fill`: secondary buttons; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

secondary-fill-dark.label: Secondary fill, dark
secondary-fill-dark.doc: Exact dark-scheme color for `--peak-secondary-fill`: secondary buttons; outside the contrast guarantee. Unset: derived

font-family.label: Font
font-family.doc: Body font stack; unset uses Blades' system stack

options.title: Humanist sans
options.value: Seravek, "Gill Sans Nova", Ubuntu, Calibri, "DejaVu Sans", source-sans-pro, sans-serif

options.title: Geometric sans
options.value: Avenir, Montserrat, Corbel, "URW Gothic", source-sans-pro, sans-serif

options.title: Old-style serif
options.value: "Iowan Old Style", "Palatino Linotype", "URW Palladio L", P052, serif

options.title: Monospace
options.value: ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", "Source Code Pro", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

font-family-mono.label: Monospace font
font-family-mono.doc: Font stack for code, kbd, pre and samp; unset uses Blades' monospace stack

options.title: Code
options.value: "Cascadia Code", "Source Code Pro", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

font-size-min.label: Text size, small screens
font-size-min.doc: Lower bound of the fluid root size `0.875rem + 0.5vw`

font-size-max.label: Text size, large screens
font-size-max.doc: Upper bound of the fluid root size

type-ratio.label: Heading scale
type-ratio.doc: h6 is 1rem, each level up multiplies by this

heading-line-height.label: Heading line height
heading-line-height.doc: Line height of `h4`; each level up is 0.025 tighter, each level down 0.025 looser, as in Blades

display-weight.label: H1 weight
display-weight.toggle: Use a separate weight for h1 and display text

subheading-font-weight.label: H4–h6 weight
subheading-font-weight.toggle: Use a separate weight for h4–h6

heading-tracking.label: Heading letter-spacing
heading-tracking.doc: Letter-spacing of `h2`–`h4` and the site title; `h1` gets 4/3 of it and `.peak-display` 5/3, `h5`/`h6` none

button-font-weight.label: Button weight
button-font-weight.toggle: Use a separate weight for buttons
button-font-weight.doc: Weight of buttons; unset follows the body weight

font-smoothing.label: Font smoothing
font-smoothing.doc: `antialiased` renders lighter, thinner text on macOS (WebKit and Chromium)

code-max-height.label: Code block height
code-max-height.toggle: Limit the height of code blocks
code-max-height.doc: Maximum height of `pre`; taller blocks scroll. Unset: no limit

spacing.label: Spacing
spacing.doc: Base rhythm: block spacing, grid gaps, `--peak-space-*`

section-spacing.label: Section spacing
section-spacing.toggle: Use a separate space between sections

density.label: Density
density.doc: Multiplies form, nav and text spacing

measure.label: Text width
measure.doc: Maximum line length of `.peak-lead` and other running text

grid-min.label: Grid column minimum
grid-min.doc: Narrowest column of `.peak-grid-auto`, which fits as many columns as there is room for; set it per grid with `style="--peak-grid-min: …"`

sidebar-width.label: Sidebar width
sidebar-width.doc: Width of the aside in `.peak-with-sidebar` (and the theme's sidebar navigation); set it per layout with `style="--peak-sidebar-width: …"`
